name: Mirror Lake Water Sample
summary: At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, a flask of water is gathered for Jennea Cannon in Stormwind. The mages will test it for signs of altered arcane currents in local water.

sections.title: Testing the Waters of Elwynn
sections.body: Jennea Cannon sends promising apprentices to collect water from Mirror Lake. The lake lies just southwest of the Stormwind Gate, and they fill a specially prepared flask at the base of its waterfall. The Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind is concerned that the world's mystic channels remain unsettled after catastrophic conflicts. Its mages will examine the sample for stray magical taint in the waterways used by people nearby.

faq.q: What is the Mirror Lake Water Sample?
faq.answer: It is water from the waterfall at Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, held in Jennea's Flask. Novice mages gather it for testing at the Wizard's Sanctum.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon want this water sample?
faq.answer: Recent mystical upheavals across Azeroth disrupted stable magical currents. Jennea Cannon fears rogue magical energy may be altering the natural environment and poisoning local drinking water.
The sample comes from the base of the waterfall flowing into Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens if the water turns out to be magically tainted?
faq.answer: Jennea Cannon worries that prolonged drinking from Mirror Lake could cause adverse magical effects if ley currents have contaminated the water supply.

angles.text: As a mage training under the Wizard's Sanctum, you fetch this sample as an early duty. It teaches you to watch environmental ley lines and recognize wild magical seepage.
